## Standard: **Water**

Standard

W1

[Create your badge here](https://sws.flaffipony.rocks?s=W1%20%20)

### Substandards

[**Ship and Boat** (Everything on the water surface)](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Wiki/Standards/Water/Ship_and_Boat)

[**Submarine** (Everything under the water surface)](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Wiki/Standards/Water/Submarine)

### Rules of this standard

- [Navigation Lights](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Wiki/Standards/Water/Navigation_Lights)

### Feature rules

- see [global feature rules](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Wiki/Standards/Features)
- o This vehicle has an airlock to transfer people between the water outside and the inside of your vehicle
- z This vehicle can handle tsunami waves (so after the wave passes you the ship does not sink, flips upside down or becomes uncontrollable)

### Size rules

- None - This standard does not have any size dependent rules
